Build something that matters

Explore Open Roles

Redefining how security gets done

We’re building AI-driven technology that transforms how modern security teams operate, replacing manual coordination with clarity, ownership, and action at enterprise scale.

Life at Seemplicity

We fix complex problems for serious organizations. That’s why why we keep things simple inside. Direct conversations, fast decisions, and real ownership.
Across teams and time zones, we challenge ideas openly, support each other fully, and build with intention.

Our values, your impact

This is the kind of place where people take their work seriously and everything else a little less so.

We own it

We take responsibility and see things through. No waiting, no excuses.

We show up

We show up for each other and for our customers, fully and honestly.

We dare

We challenge the norm, try bold ideas, and learn fast.

We stay humble

We listen first, stay curious, and know there’s always more to learn.

We win together

We collaborate openly, debate respectfully, and succeed as one team.

We raise the bar

We hold high standards and take pride in doing things properly.

Benefits and perks

Build to support the way we work, and the people doing it.

Health coverage

Comprehensive medical support for eligible employees, with company contribution.

Retirement plans

401(k) plans in the US & pension contributions in Israel for long-term financial security.

Home office

Remote-first in the US, with a company laptop and monthly internet and phone stipend.

Refueling you

From lunch allowances to a fully stocked office kitchen, we make sure our on-site team is fueled for the day.

Marking the moments

Gift cards for holidays and birthdays as a small way we say thank you.
